dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interconnected light-intensity perimeters forming irregular closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes with high-frequency jagged edges; sharp pixel-level gradient transitions between high-intensity borders and low-intensity interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of curvilinear high-intensity pixel clusters forming a continuous network of borders; low density of localized, solid high-intensity blobs within the central dark regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral light loops form an obtuse scalene triangle oriented along the longitudinal axis of the subject's midsection.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single, circular, high-saturation red feature located on the posterior-lateral quadrant near the base of the hind flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex reticulated lattice pattern composed of high-intensity pixel filaments enclosing low-intensity polygonal and ovoid regions across the entire visible dorsal surface.
